content: Koht eri ketin mahsanih, “Kowe, nein aramas, kangala pelien doaropwe wet; ke ahpw kohwei oh lokaiaiong mehn Israel kan.”
Ngehi eri sarapeseng, e ahpw ketikihong ie pelien doaropweo pwe I en tungoalehla.
Ih eri mahsanih, “Kowe, nein aramas, kangala pelien doaropwe wet me I kihwei; kadirehkihla kapehdomwen.” Ngehi eri tungoalehla, oh kehnda duwen eh mem duwehte sukehn loangalap.
Koht eri mahsanih, “Kowe, nein aramas, kohwei rehn mehn Israel kan, oh padahkihong irail mehkoaros me I pahn mahsanihwei.
I sohte kadaruhkewei nan ehu wehi me kin lokaiahki lokaiahn liki, pwe rehn mehn Israel kante.
Ma I kadaruhkewei nan wehi kan me ar lokaia uhdahn apwal ong uhk ke en dehdehki, re uhdahn pahn rong uhk.
Ahpw sohte emen mehn Israel kan pahn men rong; re pil sohte mwahn men rong ie. Irail koaruhsie keptakailahr oh kahngohdilahr.
A met, I pahn kupwurehda pwe ke en keptaki oh kahngohdiong irail kowahlap, duwehte me irail kin wiahiong ie.
I pahn kakehleiukada pwe ke en pil kekeluwak, rasehng takai kesempwal daimon; ke dehpa masak aramas kahngohdi pwuko.”
Koht pil ketin mahsanih, “Kowe, nein aramas, tehk mwahu oh tamataman mehkoaros me I padahkihong uhk.
Ke ahpw kohwei rehn riomw pwilidak en sapwomw kan me kalipilipalahr oh padahkihong irail dahme I mahsanihong irail, mehnda ma re men rong de soh.”
Ngenen Koht eri ketin pwekiehda, I ahpw rongada ngihl ehu me duwehte ngirisek en rerrer en sahpw, me mahsanih, “Kapinga roson en KAUN-O nanleng wasa ileilehie!”
I ahpw pil rongada ngilen pehnpihr en menmour ko ar mwekimwekid nan wehwe, oh pil ngilen mehn kadahr ko, rasehng ngirisek en rerrer en sahpw.
Manaman en KAUN-O ahpw kadireiehla, nindokon ngenen Koht eh ketin pwekiehda, I ahpw nsensuwedla oh lingeringerda.
Ngehi eri patohla Tel Apip limwahn Pillap Separ, wasa me mehn Suhs me kalipilipala ko kin koukousoan ie, oh I mihmihki wasao erein rahn isuh oh wie pwunopwundoki audepen kaudiahl kapwuriamwei wet.
Kauno Ketin Idiada Esekiel en Wiahla Silepe men
Mwurin rahn isuhwo, KAUN-O ahpw ketin mahsanihong ie,
“Kowe, nein aramas, I pahn wiahkinuhkala silepen wehin Israel. Ke ahpw padahkihong irail kehkehlik kan me I pahn wiahiong uhk.
Ma I pahn mahsanih me emen pahn mehkihla dipe, ke ahpw sohte kaweidki pwe en wekidala eh mour suwed pwe en kak momour, e uhdahn pahn mehla nan dipe kan, a I pahn kapwukoahnkin uhk eh mehla.
A ma ke kalikedihsang emen nan eh mour suwed, e ahpw sohte men tokedihsang wiewia dihp, e pahn mehla nan dipe, a omw mour pahn poadoandoarla.

“Ma aramas me uhdahn mwahu men tapihada wia me suwed, I ahpw pahn kihong nan irair keper ehu, aramaso pahn mehla ma ke sohte kaweidki en tokedihsang eh suwed. E pahn mehla pwehki dipe kan, oh I sohte pahn tamanda eh wiewia mwahu kan me e wiadahr. A I pahn kapwukoahnkin uhk eh mehla.
Ma ke kaweidki aramas mwahu men en dehr wiahda dihp, a e ahpw rong uhk oh sohte wiahda dihp, e pahn mourla, oh omw mour pil pahn poadoandoarla.”
Esekiel Sohla Kak Lokaia
Ngehi eri pehmada manaman en limmen KAUN-O rehi oh patohwan rongada kapitie me mahsanihong ie, “Uhda oh kohwei nan wahwo. I pahn mahseniong uhk wasao.”
Ngehi eri patohla nan wahwo oh kilangada lingaling en KAUN-O wasao, duwehte me I kilangadahr limwahn Pillap Separ. I ahpw poaridi nanpwel,
a ngenen Koht ahpw kasihnenihiehda. KAUN-O eri mahsanihong ie, “Kohkohwei ni imwomwo, oh mihmihte loale sohte pedoisang.
Eri, kowe, nein aramas, ke pahn selikihdi sellap kei oh ke sohla pahn kak kohla wasa me mie aramas.
I pahn katengehdi lowomwen pwe ke en dehr kaweid aramas kahngohdi pwukat.

Eri, ni ei pahn pwurehng mahseniong uhk oh sapwadada lowomwen, ke ahpw pahn patohwanong irail dahme ngehi, KAUN-O, Wasa Lapalahpie, mahmahsanih. Ekei irail pahn rong uhk, a ekei pahn pohnsehseiuk, pwe irail wialahr wehi kahngohdi ehu.”
